checklist: Heading in every example matches the format exactly

text: The bump MUST follow the change types: breaking is MAJOR, new behaviour is MINOR, fix is PATCH.
checklist: Each example names the right bump for its changes

text: Each bullet MUST hold one idea and start with a verb.
checklist: No bullet joins two changes or starts with a noun

text: Existing entries MUST NEVER be edited or reordered.
checklist: Examples show old entries untouched below the new one

text: The version MUST match the frontmatter and the registry.
checklist: Procedure step 8 reports a mismatch instead of hiding it

text: The skill NEVER invents a change, version or date; unknowns are asked. "We are at X" is the current version, a previous version is never invented, and an ambiguous version is asked.
checklist: Reviewer confirms every fact in examples comes from the input

text: The entry and the reply MUST be written in the language of the user's request; an English request gets an English entry, whatever language other instructions prefer for chat.
checklist: An English request in the examples and evals gets an English entry

text: A bullet MUST NEVER add a fact, cause or qualifier (such as broken, old, small, critical) that the input does not contain.
checklist: Every word of meaning in each bullet comes from the input

text: The skill folder contains every required file.
SKILL.md has valid frontmatter, matching name and stays within 150 lines.
Preview and cover meet the factory limits.
